title: The Hand of Our God
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
The hand of our God is upon those who seek Him. In Ezra v8:21-23, we see a people fasting, humbling themselves, and trusting the Lord to lead them safely. That same confidence carried the pilgrims across uncertainty and hardship as they longed to worship God freely and walk in obedience before Him.

From Psalm v107:23-31, we are reminded that God rules the storm, hears the cry of the troubled, and brings His people into their desired haven. Freedom is a gift that must never be separated from truth, righteousness, and dependence on the Lord. As darkness grows, Christ still calls His people to shine. We are not to hide the light, but to live so faithfully that others see our good works and glorify our Father in heaven.
